name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: Non-destructive NDMF tool that analyses avatar meshes, builds mesh-UV to texture mappings, rescales UV islands to a perceptual quality target, discards unused UV regions and repacks everything into atlases. / 非破坏式 NDMF 贴图优化工具：分析网格 UV 与贴图的映射关系，按感知质量目标缩放 UV 岛，剔除未使用区域并重新打包为图集。
